segments.oily: One reviewer with normal/oily T-zone found it hydrating and effective at makeup removal, though it required more effort on waterproof mascara; another with normal/oily skin found it drying.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: many call it a staple that hydrates, softens and never leaves skin tight, while several others report it dried out their skin, caused flaking, cracking, or itchy bumps.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report balanced results with no dryness or oiliness, though one with combo skin says it destroyed their skin barrier with burning, redness and peeling.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: many describe it as gentle, non-irritating and their go-to, while others report burning, redness, swelling, or breakouts they attribute to niacinamide, salicylic acid or Cetearyl Alcohol.
segments.normal: Reviewers with normal skin report mixed results, from good hydration and no breakouts to one case of severe dryness, flaking and swollen itchy bumps.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 30s-40s calls it essential for maintaining hydration and skin health as part of an anti-aging routine, with no complaints.

concerns.aging: A 43-year-old reviewer reports it keeps her skin moisturized and healthy as part of an aging-conscious routine, with no negative effects mentioned.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe it as hydrating with no post-wash tightness; a few with dry/dehydrated skin instead report it stripped moisture, leaving skin tight, flaky or cracked.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report new redness, burning or swelling on the eyelids, jawline or face, sometimes linked to rosacea or reaction to salicylic acid/niacinamide; others say it calms redness or causes none.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits it with supporting and protecting the skin barrier; another with combination skin reports it damaged her barrier, causing burning, peeling and lasting texture changes.
concerns.spots: One reviewer says it clears pimples within days of use; another with fungal-acne-prone skin says Cetearyl Alcohol in the formula worsened her breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers with acne report significant improvement or clearing after consistent use, but a few say it caused occasional small breakouts or did not improve their acne.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with an oily T-zone describes it as hydrating without feeling oily; no reviewer reports increased oiliness from use.

extraits.titre: I wish I had listened to the one star reviews
extraits.texte: I cant explain how much i regret getting this product. My skin has never looked worse. I have normal to sry skin and this left my skin in dry flaky patches and otjer parts with swollen itchy bumps!!! I look like a tomato. I even took two days off of work because of how bad it got at first. Im slowly recovering but i still have dry cracked areas on my face and itchy bumps on my forehead. This has NEVER happened to my skin before. It took me a week to realize it was the cleanser. I thought my skin was freaking out due to the change from cold weather to warm suddenly but nope! Horrible!!!

My husband and I used this cleanser for 4 months. My skin was stripped of all its oils and was VERY dry. I have sensitive, combo skin. My husbands skin became irritated after 1 month of using it daily. He has red dots on his eyelid and around his eye (just one thankfully). I feel its due to this drying cleanser. This product also contains Titanium Dioxide which is known to cause the skin to become irritated and other skin conditions. I do NOT reccommend this product at all.

i got this product specifically to help with my combo skin and it honestly destroyed my skin barrier. My skin burned, red, peely, and overall irritated. I still have texture from this product on my face. My skin has NEVER done this before. It completed dried my skin out. Dont recommend

extraits.titre: Best thing to happen to me
extraits.texte: I have dealt with bad acne since stopping birth control when I was 19 and after SO MANY different brands after so many years (Almost 26 now) -THIS ONE WORKS. I tried CeraVe out after asking what my coworker what they use since their skin looked so clear and it was the best thing to happen to me. For the first time in years my skin looks clear and actually feels smooth and soft too! I use this and then I follow it up with the CeraVe Acne bottle then use my Tula lotion and Cerva Facial Toner. I have been doing this for a little over a year now and my skin just looks so healthy and it really eliminated my acne scars too. I also have really sensitive skin and this has never given me a bad reaction even when I first started out. I will say it took a few months of doing this on routine to get here but I AM HERE. It also is so great that CeraVe is so affordably priced. Thank you so much.

The hydrating one left a residue on my skin while the foaming one is too drying. The cream to foam is the best of both worlds for my dry dehydrated acne prone skin type. I use it as a second cleanser at night and by itself in the morning.

extraits.titre: It has skincare benefits such as hyaluronic acid, ceramid...
extraits.texte: My all time favorite facial cleanser. I've been using this for years ever since it came out. It has skincare benefits such as hyaluronic acid, ceramides, glycerin that helps protects and hydrates your skin. I have combo, sensitive, acne prone skin. I'm also in my 30's. I love that it leaves my skin feeling clean, smooth, and not irritating. It starts out as a cream and when you massage it into your skin, it foams up. On its own, it won't remove all your make up, unless you double cleanse. I usually use dhc deep cleansing oil first and then wash my face with this cleanser and it works perfectly. Overall, it's my holy grail product - it's definitely a key first step to my skin care regime and it plays really well with other products.

extraits.titre: BEWARE if you have Fungal Acne!!!
extraits.texte: I've been using this product for years and have been struggling with severe breakouts. I recently found out that this product contains Cetearyl Alcohol which exacerbates fungal acne. After a week of using La Roche-Posay Toleraine foaming cleanser my skin is breakout-free and glowing!!
